title: SGLang Qwen3 8B VDCores Batch-1 Online Serving Capture
command: Tree-sync the standalone pto-cu checkout to the H200 host, start the isolated SGLang environment for Qwen/Qwen3-8B on CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7 with context length 192, bfloat16, mem_fraction_static=0.80, and --disable-piecewise-cuda-graph, then run sglang.bench_serving with dataset_name=random-ids, tokenize_prompt, requested input length 128, requested output length 64, num_prompts=1, max_concurrency=1, request_rate=inf, and warmup_requests=0.
observation: The initial SGLang launch failed in the experimental piecewise CUDA graph path with an illegal memory access. Retrying with --disable-piecewise-cuda-graph reached server readiness. A local ShareGPT-shaped dataset made online serving pass but measured only 38 input and 44 output tokens. The random-ids/tokenize_prompt retry also completed one online request with zero failed requests, but still reported 38 input and 44 output tokens instead of the requested 128/64 VDCores policy shape.
blocker: This is a successful SGLang online-serving bring-up, but it is not imported as a paper result because measured token counts do not match the VDCores 128/64 policy and offline_throughput plus one_batch remain unresolved.

remaining_paper_gaps: make SGLang bench_serving preserve the 128/64 VDCores policy token shape
capture batch 2, 4, 8, and 16 after batch 1 is policy-shaped
repeat samples for variance and confidence intervals
